statement: The pinned public gamepadcapture fixture contains26 advertised controls and14 frames of observed post-driver evdev data, including KEY_RECORD and10-bit trigger domains. It is not raw USB/GIP or Bluetooth evidence.

applicability.revision: standard Series identity where named; Elite and other revisions excluded
applicability.scope: Artifact evidence only: fixture manifest,controls,frames. Existing corpus PR6 added evdev_trace_json support, but the fixture itself is linked as a source rather than reimported or newly promoted.
